attempt_record: CREATE TABLE "attempt_record" ("reservation" TEXT NOT NULL, "phase" TEXT NOT NULL, "progress_witness" TEXT, "resolution" TEXT, "attempt_id" TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (json_extract(reservation,'$.attempt_id')) STORED UNIQUE, "goal_id" TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (json_extract(reservation,'$.goal_id')) STORED REFERENCES "generation" ("goal_id"), "generation" INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (json_extract(reservation,'$.generation')) STORED, PRIMARY KEY ("reservation"), UNIQUE ("goal_id", "generation"), CHECK (json_extract(phase,'$.kind') IN ('reserved','claimed','failed','succeeded','resolved'))) STRICT
failed_turn_evidence: CREATE TABLE "failed_turn_evidence" ("attempt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation>0), "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_created_at" REAL NOT NULL, "worktree" TEXT NOT NULL, "admission" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (admission>0), "turn_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (turn_generation>0), "goal_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (goal_revision>=0), "turn_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(turn_id)=32), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("reason" IN ('backend_failed', 'native_preflight_timeout', 'native_preflight_exit', 'pi_input_id_unavailable', 'prestart_compaction_failed', 'session_identity_uncertain', 'input_authority_changed', 'unrecognized_followup_input', 'current_prompt_input_missing', 'assistant_final_stop_missing', 'queued_input_start_missing')), PRIMARY KEY ("attempt_id"), FOREIGN KEY ("attempt_id") REFERENCES "attempt_record" ("attempt_id")) STRICT
generation: CREATE TABLE "generation" ("goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (number>0), "lifecycle" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_id" TEXT, "ready_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id"), CHECK ((json_extract(lifecycle,'$.kind')='ready' AND attempt_id IS NULL AND length(ready_digest)=64) OR (json_extract(lifecycle,'$.kind')!='ready' AND ready_digest='')), CHECK (json_extract(lifecycle,'$.kind') IN ('ready','reserved','blocked','completed','cancelled'))) STRICT
goal_attempt_schema: CREATE TABLE "goal_attempt_schema" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("singleton" IN (1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("version" IN (6)), PRIMARY KEY ("singleton")) STRICT
goal_human_decision: CREATE TABLE "goal_human_decision" ("goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "generation" ("goal_id"), "decision_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("goal_id", "decision_id")) STRICT
goal_provider_usage: CREATE TABLE "goal_provider_usage" ("attempt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "attempt_record" ("attempt_id"), "response_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "usage_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("attempt_id", "response_id")) STRICT
